_help.tiers: How big each kind of juice is. grow = how far a piece swells past full size (0.3 = 30%); shake = how far a "no" shake moves sideways, as a share of the piece's width. Reduce motion (Settings) turns the pulse, the shake and the refresh animation off, and shows only the score total.
_help.events: Which tier each moment uses: small, medium or big. turnPulse = your glyphlings breathing at the start of your turn · noShake = tapping something you can't move · seedPop = each seed's "+1" · totalPop = the turn's total over the glyphling · refreshGrow = a new seed growing into the tray after a Refresh.
